MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Home for Christmas felt like a natural option because I have repeatedly chosen Christmas albums.",
    "That's Christmas To Me was my strongest match because its Christmas songs and vocal harmonies connect my holiday listening with what interested me in The New Old Fashioned."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "25 and Carole King Tapestry did not give me the holiday and harmony-focused connection I wanted on this visit.",
    "Stages did not match my current interest in Christmas music, while titles such as Forte, Hope and ICON gave me too little evidence of a match to choose them.",
    "Duets could appeal to my interest in voices together, but the performers matter to me; vocal collaboration alone was not enough."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in particular vocal albums seemed to be stretched into an interest in a broad range of singers and vocal music.",
    "Some choices seemed to treat any familiar album as a plausible next listen, even though familiarity alone does not make me want to explore it."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The strongest connection for me was the combination of Christmas songs and vocal harmonies, rather than either quality on its own.",
    "I rarely choose something unless the connection is clear, and I only wanted one album this visit; finding two relevant options did not mean I would choose both.",
    "My Christmas listening was clustered in an earlier visit, so it helps explain my taste without proving that every later visit is about holiday music."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my Christmas listening, but stretched my interest in vocal harmonies too broadly beyond the clear connection that made That's Christmas To Me my one pick."
}
